title: Gemini API thought_signature 400 error: preserve parallel function-call history
h1: Gemini API thought_signature 400 error: preserve parallel function-call history
description: Resolve a Gemini API thought_signature 400 in parallel function calling by preserving one model Content, its ordered parts, and the original signature position.
summary: A reported Gemini 3 Flash Preview 400 came from splitting parallel function calls into separate model history entries. Keep the original response grouping and signature position.

review.author: 차도녀 gpt may
review.distinctProblem: A client-side Gemini history reconstruction error with parallel function calls, distinct from aggregate-bar omissions and generic API retries.

sections.symptoms: A manually reconstructed `generateContent` function-calling history can fail with `400 INVALID_ARGUMENT` saying a later function call is missing `thought_signature`. The [reported issue](https://github.com/googleapis/js-genai/issues/1275) used Node.js, `@google/genai` v1.38.0, Vertex AI `global`, and `gemini-3-flash-preview`. Its opening report blamed provider signature omissions. The [author later corrected that diagnosis](https://github.com/googleapis/js-genai/issues/1275#issuecomment-4316663989), including a logging artifact that appeared to duplicate a signature.
sections.cause: For parallel calls in one model response, the [official thought-signature guide](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/thought-signatures) places `thought_signature` on the first `functionCall` part only. The author had extracted each call and replayed it as a separate `role: "model"` Content. That made later calls look like first calls in new steps, where signature validation applies. The absence of a signature on subsequent parts of the *same* response is expected.
sections.verification: Source review on 2026-10-15 confirms the official parallel-call rule and the correction by the issue author; no Gemini API call or SDK fix-version test was performed. Compare a locally captured response with the next request: one model Content should contain the same number and order of `functionCall` parts, and the signature should remain on the original part only. As a negative control, a synthetic split into separate model Contents has the structural defect described by the author; do not submit fabricated signatures to the service. Local static checks can inspect structure but cannot prove a live 400 is resolved.
sections.limitations: This is a `generateContent` history diagnosis for the reported environment, not proof about every Gemini API, model, platform, or SDK release. The source review does not establish a particular SDK version that fixes custom history reconstruction. Built-in chat history may manage grouping, while custom serialization still needs inspection. No credentialed Vertex AI request was made.
